source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject creation of another TC-D1 requirement tree.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 payload explicitly excludes creating another TC-D1 requirement tree, but no proposed obligation rejects that scope.
source_gap_claims.subject: TC-D1 requirement-tree scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject redesign of Skill-input v1/current-pointer semantics or Skill-input v2.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 payload excludes redesigning the Skill-input v1/current-pointer semantics and requires preserving current Skill-input v2 behavior, but no proposed obligation represents this prohibition.
source_gap_claims.subject: Skill-input design scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require a real defect-revealing test before a production behavior change, reject fabricated RED evidence, and require truthful characterization for existing passing brownfield behavior.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 payload makes this an independent implementation constraint, but no proposed obligation covers the required test ordering and evidence integrity behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Defect-revealing test discipline

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject Memory, SkillOS, percentage-canary, generalized-governance, review-topology-experiment, and cross-plan-observability features outside TC-D1 evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 payload excludes these feature classes independently; the proposed obligations cover Miner, Curator, autonomous modification, ranking, and reinforcement learning only.
source_gap_claims.subject: Additional TC-D1 non-goal feature scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a successful semantic result when a validator, descriptor, dependency, support policy, or scope changes jointly without a new matching independent Trust Approval.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 payload requires a new content-matched, candidate-external Trust Approval for such changes; the proposed obligations verify components but do not represent this approval/freshness condition as an independent behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Joint validator-trust change handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require each Probe to bind its actual target, command, result, and output evidence in addition to its input.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Probe oracle requires all five bindings. Proposed Probe obligations bind inputs and outputs and require a real process, but do not independently require actual-target, command, and result bindings.
source_gap_claims.subject: Probe identity and execution bindings

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require each Consumer to bind its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies, and prevent a success path from making a required route check unreachable.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Consumer contract includes these independently observable bindings and reachability constraint; the proposed transition obligations require real call surfaces but do not cover the complete binding set or reachability rule.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer invocation bindings and route reachability

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require any Consumer applicability exception to be explicitly approved and bound before execution.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 route-transition and Consumer contracts prohibit implementation-selected skipped transitions; no proposed obligation covers approval and binding of an applicability exception.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer transition applicability exceptions

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require Stable to have verifiable provenance and immutable identity bound before the run, and reject a temporary run-created package as Stable merely because it differs from Candidate.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Stable-eligibility contract requires these distinct conditions; proposed matrix obligations require immutable Stable execution but omit provenance and the temporary-package rejection behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable subject eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require Candidate to contain the relevant real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Stable/Candidate definition and matrix contract require this independently observable subject qualification; no proposed obligation represents it.
source_gap_claims.subject: Candidate subject eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Invalidate the matrix aggregate for duplicate evidence, expectation-forged cases, undeclared diagnostics, or copied expected output.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 matrix contract lists these independent invalidation conditions. The proposed FR-8 obligations cover reused/copied/mislabeled/stale/wrong-target/infrastructure/non-executed evidence, but not duplicate evidence, forged expectations, undeclared diagnostics, or copied expected output.
source_gap_claims.subject: Additional matrix evidence invalidation conditions

source_gap_claims.behavior: Preserve historical and failed-candidate evidence while keeping new evidence isolated between subjects, Probes, cases, Consumers, and route stages.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Consumer and rollback contract requires preservation of failed-candidate evidence and stage-specific isolation. Proposed obligations cover general evidence isolation but do not represent this preservation requirement.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical and failed-candidate evidence preservation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Prevent serialized terminal-category aliases from merging a failure into success or silently reinterpreting terminal categories.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Result and Snapshot contract defines this terminal-category compatibility constraint; no proposed obligation covers it.
source_gap_claims.subject: Terminal-category serialization compatibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Permit timestamp or process-ID variation only when it cannot affect selection, observation, diagnostics, evidence validity, or authority.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 Result and Snapshot contract explicitly limits portable runtime-metadata variation; no proposed obligation represents this condition.
source_gap_claims.subject: Portable runtime-metadata variation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require a measured full-matrix, Consumer, and rollback timing basis before implementation authorization; until then, timeout remains mandatory and exhaustion fails.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 authority companion states this conditional, independently observable budget-governance requirement. Proposed bounded-execution obligations omit the measurement-before-authorization condition.
source_gap_claims.subject: Execution-budget authorization prerequisite

source_gap_claims.behavior: Block reliance on product-scope approval, alternate validator-source approval, or Consumer Manifest exceptions until the specified existing authorized repository or ADR owner is confirmed and the required approval is bound.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 authority companion defines these unresolved-authority fail-closed conditions; the proposed obligation set does not cover them.
source_gap_claims.subject: Open authority dependency handling
